rv.q: GRIM is funny, imaginative, visually engaging, and surprisingly heartfelt.
Beneath the jokes and theatrical spectacle lies a profound reminder that our mortality is precisely what makes life so precious.

cn.t: GRIM charms with catchy pop-Broadway tunes, colorful staging, and an inventive premise, but critics agree this world premiere is still finding its footing. Entertaining and full of potential, though not yet fully polished.

vr.q: I do see so much potential with what is already present here with Grim
